research_result.description: iPayX is an FX forensic audit platform that enables AI agents and businesses to audit foreign exchange rates, compute hidden bank markups, and generate FINTRAC-certified forensic reports.
research_result.credential_requirements: Basic rate checks and transaction audits can be performed without authentication. Access to full forensic reports and live provider comparisons requires an API key sent as a Bearer token.

evidence.claim: iPayX provides an open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for foreign exchange forensic auditing.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The world's first Model Context Protocol server for foreign exchange forensic auditing.

evidence.claim: iPayX requires a Bearer token / API key for full forensic report generation while offering basic endpoints without auth.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: **Auth:** Bearer token (API key required) | **Cost:** Per report

evidence.claim: iPayX provides a REST API and SDKs for FX audit automation.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: REST API + SDKs for FX audit automation.

evidence.claim: iPayX offers a free tier with initial free audits before usage-based pricing.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Five free audits. Then transparent usage-based pricing.
